name: NoteSR - Encrypted Notes
tagline: Secure offline notes with AES-256 encryption and encrypted file attachments.
blurb: NoteSR is a privacy-first, offline note app that keeps your data on your device.
description:
NoteSR is a privacy-first, offline note app that keeps your data on your device.

Create text notes, attach files, and open attachments directly in the app, all protected with AES-256 encryption. No account, no cloud sync, and no tracking.

• Encrypted local storage for notes and attachments

• Fully offline usage (no internet required)

• Built-in viewer for common file types

• Encrypted export/import for backup and restore

• Simple, minimal interface focused on privacy

NoteSR is designed for people who want secure personal notes, journals, and sensitive files without giving up control of their data.
